title: Global existence for Consensus-Based Kinetic Models for Image Segmentation
summary: In this article, we analyze a recently introduced kinetic model based on Hegselmann-Krause-type interaction dynamics describing consensus-based image segmentation in the mean-field regime, where particle density depends on spatial coordinates and the normalized gray level (feature) value.
